kate: Heads-up: Meridian Bank wants a 3-day POC. Requirements: live token streaming in a small UI, final JSON strictly validated against a schema, and a CRM lookup that must only see their IPs. Also asked for reserved pilot pricing and SOC2/SSO docs.

omar: Recommend a lightweight customer-run connector in their VPC for CRM calls so CRM only sees customer IPs. For demo we can run a local proxy to illustrate the flow. If they insist on Redwood static IPs, that requires Dedicated NAT ranges and network review.

lucy: On schema enforcement: we can enable runtime validation and choose behavior: block + return structured error, or auto-retry with a constrained prompt. For exec demo they want a hard block if malformed. We'll show block + audit log entry.

sec-bot: I can attach SAML/OIDC integration guide, SOC2 summary, and audit log export docs (90d). Also KMS integration notes for Dedicated/Private.

devex-bot: Tiny snippet for the repo (python streaming + schema validation) that Kate can drop into the demo:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="REDACTED")
# stream tokens
for chunk in client.generate_stream(model="rwd-small-1", prompt="Lookup customer 321 and return JSON:"):
    print(chunk.text, end="")
# final validated call
resp = client.generate(model="rwd-small-1", prompt="Produce JSON {\"customer_id\":int,\"status\":string}", output_schema='{"type":"object","properties":{"customer_id":{"type":"integer"},"status":{"type":"string"}},"required":["customer_id","status"]}', validate_schema=True)
if resp.valid:
    forward_to_connector(resp.json)
else:
    print('validation failed', resp.errors)
```

kate: Action items: omar create connector README and local proxy instructions; lucy configure runtime validation to block malformed outputs and log failures; sec-bot post docs; I'll draft three pricing tiers (hosted trial, 1-month reserved pilot, 6-month pilot) and share with Meridian.
